title: [Exhaust] ability cannot be activated
expected: Parser (riftbound-cards/src/parser/impl/effects-might.ts:121-139) emits The List's exhaust effect with target filter { tag: "named" } as a literal placeholder. The engine's filter matcher (riftbound-engine/src/abilities/target-resolver.ts:737-739) compares filter.tag literally against the card definition's tags array (`tags?.includes(filter.tag)`), so it looks for a unit whose printed tag is the string "named" — never true for Pouty Poro (tag "Poro"). There is no engine support for "As you play this, name a tag": grep for 'name a tag'/'named' in riftbound-engine/src finds nothing, and labelCard (game-definition/moves/card-actions.ts:88-95) only writes meta.label, which target-resolver never consults for tag filters. Hence no legal target exists, activateAbility is not enumerated, and direct execution fails the target condition.
observed: pw moves lists no activateAbility for The List; direct executeMove/REST activateAbility returns CONDITION_FAILED (target filter {tag:'named'} never matches because no tag can be named). Manually labelCard='Poro' did not help either.
